decisions.statement: A reason is worth another try only where another try in this same run would meet a different world.
A landing another landing's lock refused is asked for again.
A landing refused for a tree that moved under the landing is asked for again.
The words each of those refusals is known by come from the module wording it.
A refusal naming neither is answered at once.
A landing is asked for five times at most.
An ask is made thirty seconds after the ask that refused.
A landing that ends in an error answers that error as a reason of its own.
A reason made from an error says it was an error rather than a refusal.
A landing whose error names the lock is asked for again as a refusal naming it is.
No error a landing ends in reaches past the ask that asked for that landing.
A reason made from an error names what the run had done before that error.
What the run had done by then is handed in rather than read back.
Nothing is added to a reason the landing itself worded.
A module a run could not find stays unfound for the rest of that run.
A landing that could not find a module is answered at once rather than asked for again.
Nothing here composes what a landing lands or reads what a landing wrote.

definition: a landing asked for again after a reason that clears while the run waits
